description: This Java class 'PolicyQueryResponseSignalMapper' maps policy query response signals within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It extends an abstract query signal mapper and implements response signal mapping, performing validation, topic path creation, and payload enhancement for policy query responses.

classes.name: PolicyQueryResponseSignalMapper
classes.description: A class responsible for mapping policy query response signals, including validation, topic path building, and payload enhancement.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the response name ends with 'response'; throws an exception if not.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Creates a TopicPathBuilder scoped to policies for a given policy query response.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Adds status and entity information to the payload builder based on the response.
